deep_analysis:
3/3 LONG in a SHORT_BIAS aggregate tape (22:00 dump: 5 long / 56 short / 62 neutral), but the tape for OUR tape-condition improved this cycle: continuum trend_quality STRONG_DOWN → STRONG_UP, linreg LEAN_BEAR → NEUTRAL, BTC +131 pts above EMA300 (was +25), 486 min above, consecutive_below=0. The EMA300 hold condition is what makes these longs the right side — re-tested at 22:14, still holding (price 80458 vs EMA300 80328). Exit trigger unchanged: 3 consecutive 1m closes below EMA300 ≈ 80328 → cut all three.

The real finding this cycle is HYPE #16383: it printed a peak of +0.885% (76.63 at 20:01, with 72 one-minute closes ≥ +0.40%) and round-tripped all the way back to entry (+0.06%) — and NOTHING owns its stop. Verified: hl_copy_trader is in PROFIT_MONSTER_BYPASS_SIGNALS (profit_monster never trails it), the signal is not in manual_exit_manager MANAGED_TAGS (BE-lock/tiered trail never runs), hl_sl_order_id/hl_tp_order_id are None (no exchange-side ratchet), and stop_loss is still the entry-time 75.7301. The only exits available are the -0.30% ATR SL, the +1.69% TP, or a leader exit copied by hl_fill_monitor. A +0.885% MFE that books zero is exactly the giveback machine: 14d ARM-GAP verified this cycle = 34 closed trades with MFE>=0.40 that never trailed, 0W, -2.24 USDT; armed-trail exits are 134T/106W/+9.94 vs unarmed 193T/16W/-13.09.

Position quality split: BTC #16385 entered at meta_rsi 5.48 = the LONG <35 bucket (7d: 4T/3W/+0.17) on continuum+ (7d 100% WR) — correct side, keep. HBAR #16386 entered at meta_rsi 56.5 = the mid-band 45-60 bucket (7d: 43T/17W/39.5%/-1.35, the single largest loss bucket) on bb-bounce-v2-long+ (7d 17T/-0.58) — the weakest of the three; it is currently holding above entry (0.07756-0.07760 vs 0.077515, MFE +0.226%) so the 22:42 deadline is benign for now. HYPE is on hl_copy_trader (7d 0W/4T/-0.21, all-time 30% WR) at meta_rsi 26.79.

Volatility is the silent enemy: BTC ATR 0.072%/1h, HYPE 0.121%, HBAR 0.152% — LOW regime. None of the three trades has armed a trail (max MFE 0.885/0.25/0.23 vs 0.40 arm), and low-vol entries are the pre-trail bucket where 52/52 7d trades died (0W, -4.59). All three trades are one position: same tape, same EMA300 exit condition, one BTC dump hits all.

24h realized is healthy (11T/9W/+1.06) and every win came through the exit machinery (trail/manual-trail/HL close). The book wins when trades arm trails and when shorts/momentum extremes fire; it loses on mid-band longs in low-vol chop — which is one of our three open trades.

Sources at 22:00-22:16 UTC disagree — cite the source with any direction call.
- regime_5m aggregate: SHORT_BIAS (long_bias 5 / short_bias 56 / neutral 62 of 123), timestamp 22:00.
- regimes.BTC (15m): NEUTRAL.
- watchdog btc_15m and btc_4h: both SHORT_BIAS.
- continuum (1m, 22:14): price 80458 AT/above EMA300 80328 (+131), ema300_duration 486 min, consecutive_below 0, linreg_direction NEUTRAL (was LEAN_BEAR at 21:44), trend_quality STRONG_UP (was STRONG_DOWN), wyckoff DISTRIBUTION, state_score 33.2 (was 21.7), volatility LOW, volume LOW, velocity SLOW.
Flip-rate KPI (mandatory): aggregate 16 flips/24h, BTC 15m 16 flips/24h over 96 dumps — inside the calibrated band (full-log p50=19, p95=26), i.e. the standing high-churn state, NOT an anomaly. <6 (real trend tape) has not occurred since Oct 2.
Implication: direction states survive ~1h; condition-key every directional steer and re-test next cycle. Position fit: portfolio 3/3 LONG against a SHORT_BIAS aggregate — the only thing aligning us is BTC's 1m holding above EMA300. If that breaks, we are long with no trend cover in a LOW-vol tape. The 30-min improvement (linreg NEUTRAL, trend_quality STRONG_UP) is why the hold-conditions-long steer stands rather than an urgent exit.
pattern_alerts:
All figures verified from PostgreSQL this cycle (RSI = _signal_metadata.rsi_14, never entry_rsi_14).

PATTERN 1 — trail-armed vs unarmed, 14d: trailing_activated=TRUE 134T/106W (79%)/+9.94 vs FALSE 193T/16W (8%)/-13.09. ARM-GAP subset (MFE>=0.40, never trailed, negative): 34T/0W/-2.24. 7d exit families: trail 59T/45W/+3.45 vs pre_trail (atr_sl/hard_max_loss/hard_sl/stale/cut_loser) 52T/0W/-4.59.
WINNING SIDE: trades whose stop ratchets after +0.40%. WHY WE AREN'T ON IT right now: HYPE crossed +0.40% on 72 minute-closes and no mechanism armed (bypass design), and none of the 3 open trades has an active trail. The unarmed cohort is where the -13.09 lives.

PATTERN 2 — LONG mid-band is the largest loss bucket, 7d (meta_rsi): LONG <35 4T/3W/+0.17 | 35-45 6T/2W/-0.26 | 45-60 43T/17W (39.5%)/-1.35 | 60+ 18T/9W/+0.39. SHORT <35 1T/1W/+0.04 | 35-45 13T/7W/+0.19 | 45-60 10T/2W/-0.26 | 60+ 9T/6W (67%)/+0.91.
WINNING SIDE: momentum extremes (SHORT 60+, LONG <35 or 60+). WHY WE AREN'T ON IT: HBAR #16386 opened LONG at meta_rsi 56.5, dead centre of the 39.5% bucket, on bb-bounce-v2-long+ (7d 17T/-0.58). BTC at 5.48 and HYPE at 26.79 are in the correct <35 bucket — the mid-band long is the one to watch.

PATTERN 3 — signal families, 7d n>=5: LOSING: pump-chain+ 14T/14.3%WR/-0.88, bb-bounce-v2-long+ 17T/47%/-0.58, ai-trader-pending 16T/25%/-0.14, hl_copy_trader 7d 0W/4T/-0.21 (all-time 30% WR). WINNING: pump-chain- family, bb-squeeze+, volume-buildup- (57% WR), continuum-trend+ (80% WR), continuum+ 100% (small n).
WINNING SIDE: continuation/short/squeeze families. WHY WE AREN'T ON IT: 2 of 3 open trades ride the two weakest long families in the book.

PATTERN 4 — last 24h: 11 closed / 9W / +1.06. Shorts 6W/8T; the two losers were CHIP SHORT (RSI 63 trail giveback) and BTC SHORT (manual SL -3.42%). No repeat-failure streak — the failure pattern of record is the 7d mid-band long and the pre-trail bucket, not anything from the last 24h.
